input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && git status && echo "--- STASH ---" && git stash list && echo "--- LOG ---" && git log --oneline -5 && echo "--- BRANCH ---" && git branch --show-current

cd /workspace/inventory && echo "--- .env (keys only) ---" && sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' .env && echo "--- references to env ---" && rg -n "dotenv|\.env|getenv|environ" --glob '!.git' . | head -30 && echo "--- var/ ---" && find var -type f | head -20
cd /workspace/inventory && git clean -fdx && git reset --hard HEAD && rm -rf var/ && echo "--- post-reset status ---" && git status --short && ls -a
cd /workspace/inventory && find src tests -type f -name '*.py' | sort && echo "=== pricing.py ===" && cat -n src/inventory/pricing.py
cd /workspace/inventory && cat -n tests/test_pricing.py && echo "=== conftest.py ===" && cat -n tests/conftest.py && echo "=== pyproject.toml ===" && cat pyproject.toml
cd /workspace/inventory && rg -n "line_total" --glob '!.git' . && echo "=== report.py ===" && cat -n src/inventory/report.py && echo "=== stock.py ===" && cat -n src/inventory/stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/pricing.py /tmp/p.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path("src/inventory/pricing.py")
p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('    if qty <= 0:\n        raise ValueError("qty must be positive")\n',''))
EOF
echo "--- without guard ---"; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_pricing.py 2>&1 | tail -5; cp /tmp/p.bak src/inventory/pricing.py; echo "--- restored ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "--- diff ---"; git diff
